@ an input at sample * 4 under down 4 is the 4 frames before the tick, x[3] the latest: 4321, 8765, 13209
@ an input at sample * 2 under down 4 is read at sample / 2: the frames c - 4 and c - 2, before the value of the frame c
@ two inputs at sample * 2 are two rings: the first is the digits 1 and 10, the second 1000 and 10000
@ an input that is no port of sample * M is read at the tick, a block value for a port is gathered at each frame
process 0 params p=0x3f800000 frames=3 in x=[0x3f800000 0x40000000 0x40400000]
@ an init value and a constant passed to a port are gathered too: the first block is T.default(), not the value
@ an argument that is a delay of a slower tick is read before its store: the value of the tick before
@ an output at sample * 4 is dealt to the 4 frames from the tick, the parameter of the call of the tick
@ an output at sample * 2 under down 4 is at sample / 2: element 0 for the frames c and c + 1, element 1 for c + 2 and c + 3
@ a struct output is dealt as the elements of an array that has its Default by hand
@ a flow that gathers and deals the same array is delay~(x, N): N samples late, 0 at first
@ the elements of the ring and of the array are in order: a reversal inside the block
@ a slower input and a slower output together: the same as a delay of 2 ticks of sample / 2
@ down 4 down 2 gathers at one boundary: the same values as down 8
@ the replicas of a par~ have a ring each, and an argument reads the index of the replica
@ the arms of a match~ all gather, and the arm that is not taken binds the default
@ a chain that gathers inside a part under down 2: the ring is written at the part's sample, the caller's even frames
@ a chain that gathers what a chain dealt: the dealt elements of each tick are the ring
@ one call of 12 frames gives the values worked out: a gather at sample / 4 and a deal at sample / 2 in one flow
- the calls of process cut the run anywhere, a call of 0 frames too: the same values
- twelve calls of one frame give the same
@ reset after 6 frames, the phase 2 of 4: the ring and the counter are the initial ones
- reset after any number of frames, at a tick or between: the run of a state just made
@ reset in the middle of a phase restarts the counter of a part that deals: the next frame is its tick
